name: boundary length
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中列车长度之外用于计算边界处理的轨道附加长度。
usage_overview: 用于有限长度轨道模型的边界处理，指列车前后额外保留的结构区段。设置这部分长度是为了减弱截断边界反射对列车作用区域动力响应的影响。

complete_examples.text: The train–track system is coupled as an entire one by matrix equations, only demanding a rather limited modeling length, namely satisfying being larger than the total length of a train and two times the boundary length, and then, the infinite length of a train moving on tracks can be achieved by a cyclic calculation method.
Q. ZHANG ET AL. It can be clearly seen from Figure 12 that the shorter of the bridge span length, the smaller of the boundary length required, in the guaranteeing of the solution convergence.
By selecting the minimum boundary length lb, the time consumption is greatly reduced in the modelling solution.
